auditor_value: F_min = μmg/(cosθ + μ sinθ) = mg sinφ / cos(θ − φ)

findings.quote: Forgetting the cos(θ − φ) factor in the denominator and stopping at the numerator alone gives mg sinφ.
findings.note: Vague, invented cause: no working step 'stops at the numerator'. The genuine route to option 4 is minimising over θ as well (the overall least pull is mg sinφ at θ = φ) when the question fixes θ.
findings.fix: Minimising over the pull angle as well, which gives the overall least pull mg sinφ (reached only at θ = φ), when the question fixes θ and asks for the least F at that angle.

notes: Answer agrees. All four equations check, including the identity sinφ/(cosθ cosφ + sinθ sinφ) = sinφ/cos(θ − φ).
